subject: Co-innovation: IntegrateLabs LangChain/LlamaIndex tracing + co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@integratelabs.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood + Integrate Labs: LangChain/LlamaIndex tracing + co-sell interest

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking the intro last week — following up with a brief on what Integrate Labs is proposing. We build a lightweight tracing SDK and prompt-inspection tooling for LangChain and LlamaIndex that adds minimal latency and ships backwards-compatible telemetry hooks. We think there are two clear collaboration paths:

- Integration + joint documentation: embed our tracer as an optional shim in Redwood SDKs so mutual customers can get end-to-end observability with one flag.
- Co-sell and certification: a short readiness checklist + marketplace listing to expose Integrate Labs as a recommended partner.

Attached is a short integration brief and a draft commercial 1-pager. Can we get a technical sync next week? Also happy to fill your standard security questionnaire — copied Samir (eng lead) to help with details.

Attachments: integ_integration_brief.pdf, sow-draft-v1.docx

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Partnerships
Integrate Labs
laura@integratelabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@integratelabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Aug 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Integrate Labs: LangChain/LlamaIndex tracing + co-sell interest

Laura — thanks for the brief and the clear options. This looks promising and aligns with our ISV program priorities for Q4. A few quick notes: 

1) Security/compliance: we will need your completed security questionnaire and evidence for SOC 2 controls around telemetry collection (PII filtering, retention policies). Please use the attached XLS template and return by EOW.
2) Technical sync: mid next week works. Karthik (cc'd) will be our runtime engineering lead for the integration review; Marissa will own partnership ops and go-to-market.
3) Certification criteria: we prefer a light-narrow checklist (SDK install, backward-compat tests, unit/infra smoke tests, performance benchmark <5% p50 token latency delta). We'll draft an acceptance checklist and share.

Can Samir or the Eng team send a short compatibility matrix (supported LangChain/LlamaIndex versions, minimum python/node versions, and where the tracer hooks into the call stack)? Also confirm whether the tracer uses persistent storage or just emits events to a configured endpoint.

I'll schedule a 60m technical sync: propose Tue 2028-08-22 10:00 PT — please confirm.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
redwood.ai

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@integratelabs.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Aug 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Integrate Labs: LangChain/LlamaIndex tracing + co-sell interest

Laura — quick technical follow-ups ahead of Tue's sync. Quoting your note below: 

On Fri, 18 Aug 2028 at 09:12 Laura Chen <laura@integratelabs.com> wrote:
> We build a lightweight tracing SDK and prompt-inspection tooling for LangChain and LlamaIndex that adds minimal latency and ships backwards-compatible telemetry hooks.

Questions from runtime/observability side:
- Is the tracer implemented as an importable shim or an adapter that wraps the runtime call path? If shim, what's the startup cost (ms) for cold processes?
- Does the tracer maintain any KV-cache or local state between calls (we need to ensure it doesn't conflict with our prefix/KV caching)?
- How does the tracer instrument streaming responses and function/tool calling (we require token-level correlation IDs for our tracing pipeline)?
- Can you provide a small perf micro-benchmark (LLama-7B/sequence 1024) showing p50/p95 token latency impact with tracer enabled vs disabled?

If you have a lightweight demo app or a repo we can run ahead of the sync, please share. Also please attach the security questionnaire when you return it — we'll use that to start our internal legal/infra review.

Thanks — Marissa
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 18 Aug 2028 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Integrate Labs: LangChain/LlamaIndex tracing + co-sell interest

Laura / Samir — thanks for the brief and for looping us in. To keep the sync focused, here's a proposed agenda and pre-reqs: 

Proposed tech sync agenda (60m):
- 5m intros and goals (product/partner/eng)
- 15m Integrate Labs architecture walkthrough (how tracer attaches to LangChain/LlamaIndex)
- 15m demo: streaming + token correlation use-case
- 15m perf & compatibility Qs (benchmarks + version matrix)
- 10m next steps (SOW, certification checklist, timeline)

Pre-reqs (please share ahead of sync):
- Compatibility matrix (supported versions + runtime languages) — single slide or table
- Perf micro-bench (LLama-7B, seq 1024) showing p50/p95 delta with tracer on/off
- Security questionnaire completed (security-questionnaire.xlsx)
- Draft SOW if you prefer standard clauses (we attached a PoC SOW template; if you want to use your own, send it ahead)

Scheduling: Tue 2028-08-22 10:00 PT confirmed for our side — calendar invite sent. I've added a placeholder DocuSign link (will update when SOW is ready): https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/0x9fe

Looking forward — Karthik
